summary: Israeli Defense Minister Katz announced Israel would target all Iranian national, military, and civilian infrastructure including energy facilities if Iran attacks. IDF forces in northern Gaza identified and eliminated a Hamas terrorist who crossed the yellow line and posed an immediate threat. A multi-front security assessment was held between Defense Minister Katz and IDF Chief of Staff Zamir amid escalating tensions.
key_points: Defense Minister Katz declared at Rosh Hashanah ceremony that Iranian attack would release Israel from all restrictions, targeting all national infrastructure including energy facilities, (Source: @VahidOnline/78207).
IDF forces in northern Gaza identified a terrorist crossing the yellow line and approaching forces in an immediate threat; IAF struck and eliminated him, (Source: @New_security8200/203585).

Hamas militants fired at IDF forces east of the yellow line in northern Gaza for the first time in an extended period; no Israeli casualties, IDF responded with an attack, (Source: @almogboker78/18126).
IDF completed clearing Hezbollah's underground facility beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon ahead of demolition, (Source: @shin_persian/9441).
Defense Minister Katz held multi-front security assessment with IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir and senior military officials amid Iranian threats, (Source: @manniefabian/59090).
Oman rejected Iran's proposal for joint fee collection from commercial ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz, according to New York Post citing regional official, (Source: @VahidOnline/78227).
US Treasury announced up to $10 million reward for information on Amir Yariab, head of IRGC Navy Cyber Command, (Source: @kianmeli1/91498).

VP JD Vance stated all options against Iran remain on the table including economic, military, diplomatic pressure and covert operations, and US will not negotiate until Iran stops shooting at ships, (Source: @SharghDaily/181705).

sections.executive_summary: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz announced at a Rosh Hashanah ceremony that an Iranian attack would release Israel from all restrictions, with Israel prepared to strike all national, military, and civilian infrastructure including energy facilities, (Source: @VahidOnline/78207). IDF forces operating in northern Gaza identified and eliminated a Hamas terrorist who crossed the yellow line and posed an immediate threat to forces, with no Israeli casualties reported, (Source: @New_security8200/203585). A multi-front security assessment was conducted between Defense Minister Katz and IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir alongside senior military and security officials amid the heightened threat environment.

points: Defense Minister Katz declared that Iran's attack on Israel would release Israel from all restrictions, stating Israel would target all national, military, and civilian infrastructure including energy facilities, and would return Iran to the Stone Age and darkness, (Source: @VahidOnline/78207).

Katz noted that economic pressure and concerns about uprising and regime collapse may push Iran toward desperate actions, acknowledging signs that such pressures are mounting on Tehran, (Source: @inon_yttach/10009).
US Treasury announced a reward of up to $10 million for information on Amir Yariab, head of the IRGC Navy Cyber Command, indicating heightened cyber threat focus, (Source: @kianmeli1/91498).

Iranian hackers allegedly targeted over 100 water systems in 7 US states according to Fox News citing CIA; a hacker group warned of unexpected critical events in telecommunications ahead, (Source: @kianmeli1/91497).

Iranian Speaker of Parliament Ghalibaf responded to US Treasury Secretary Bessent, dismissing his rhetoric as childish boasts and declaring Washington's war against Iran shattered the illusion of American hegemony, (Source: @presstv/205439).
Iranian Embassy in London condemned US for deadly attacks on wedding ceremonies in Afghanistan, Iraq, and Yemen, citing latest incident in Iran's Hormozgan Province, (Source: @presstv/205441).

VP JD Vance stated Iran is losing capabilities day by day and the US attacked Iran to prevent nuclear weapons and protect commercial shipping; all options remain on the table, (Source: @SharghDaily/181705).

Defense Minister Katz held a multi-front security assessment with IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir and senior military and security officials amid escalating Iranian threats, (Source: @manniefabian/59090).

IDF announced completion of clearing Hezbollah's underground facility beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, ahead of demolition, demonstrating continued northern operations, (Source: @shin_persian/9441).
Netanyahu told the General Staff Forum he is convinced of Israel's ability to overthrow the Iranian regime, calling it the central mission that is close to achievement, (Source: @amitsegal/64540).
Trump stated Israel has enough ammunition for a military operation in Iran and the US is preparing for any possible scenario, (Source: @lelotsenzura/94304).
IDF Brigade 210 completed an exercise in the Golan Heights involving dozens of scenarios and management of emerging events to enhance operational readiness, (Source: @New_security8200/203584).

IDF Spokesperson reported forces operating in northern Gaza identified a terrorist crossing the yellow line posing immediate threat; IAF struck and eliminated him while forces continue operations per agreement, (Source: @New_security8200/203585).

For the first time in an extended period, Hamas militants fired at IDF forces operating east of the yellow line in northern Gaza; no Israeli casualties were reported and IDF responded with an attack in the area, (Source: @almogboker78/18126).

IDF forces in northern Gaza identified a terrorist who crossed the yellow line and approached forces in a manner constituting immediate threat; the IAF struck and eliminated the terrorist to remove the threat, (Source: @New_security8200/203585).
Israeli occupation vehicles fired illumination flares over the Al-Teffuh neighborhood east of Gaza City, (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388712).
The Erez crossing closure is deepening Gaza's economic crisis according to a report from Minas Al-Jabbour, (Source: @presstv/205442).
A stabbing attack attempt was documented at Sha'ar Shechem ( Jaffa Gate) in Jerusalem; authorities advise to stay updated for further content, (Source: @pkpoi/143834).

IDF announced completion of clearing Hezbollah's underground facility beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon ahead of demolition, marking significant progress in underground infrastructure neutralization, (Source: @shin_persian/9441).
Artillery shelling was reported targeting the Mansouri area according to live map updates from Red Link Lebanon, (Source: @redlinkleb/40605).

Red Link Lebanon reported a technical malfunction affecting the map display of drones and combat aircraft, advising followers to monitor the channel directly until service restoration, (Source: @redlinkleb/40615).
ISIS claimed it targeted an IRGC-backed PMU/Hashed Al-Shaabi vehicle in the Anbar desert in Iraq, (Source: @shin_persian/9438).
Drone activity was reported heard in Erbil province in northern Iraq, (Source: @naya_foriraq/89343).

US announced it would demand European countries compensate the US for military aid and munitions previously sent to Ukraine, while signaling possible halt to further arms sales to allies, (Source: @naya_foriraq/89328).

Oman rejected Iran's proposal for joint collection of fees from commercial ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz; the regional official stated Muscat did not even agree to voluntary environmental and security fees from ships, (Source: @VahidOnline/78227).

VP JD Vance stated only the US can guarantee continued global energy supply; Iran shooting at commercial ships is causing gasoline price increases and without US protection, a catastrophic global energy crisis would occur, (Source: @SharghDaily/181705).

Trump posted on Truth Social comparing pre-war Hormuz oil and gas volume of approximately 20 million barrels per day with current levels, declaring Hormuz oil has returned, (Source: @VahidOnline/78214).
Arab Gulf countries told the US that American departure from the region would be the worst possible outcome, (Source: @SharghDaily/181705).

US Army succeeded in moving 40 tankers carrying approximately 18 million barrels of oil on Tuesday, a daily record since war began and slightly less than pre-war Suez Canal volume of 20 million barrels, (Source: @asafroz/53058).

sections.threat_assessment: The threat environment has escalated significantly with Defense Minister Katz's explicit declaration that Israel will target all Iranian national infrastructure including energy facilities if Iran attacks, effectively abandoning previous operational constraints. The simultaneous completion of Hezbollah's underground facility clearance in southern Lebanon indicates Israel is maintaining multi-front operational tempo while preparing for potential Iranian retaliation. Hamas's resumption of fire at IDF forces in northern Gaza represents a potential breach of existing arrangements, though Israeli responses remain measured and targeted. Iranian cyber capabilities continue targeting US critical infrastructure with over 100 water systems reportedly compromised across 7 states.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are positioning themselves amid escalating US-Iran confrontation. Oman has rejected Iran's scheme to jointly collect fees from ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz, undermining Tehran's revenue extraction strategy and aligning with US-led maritime security framework. Gulf states have reportedly told the US that American regional withdrawal would constitute the worst possible outcome, demonstrating continued reliance on US security guarantees. VP Vance's explicit statement that all options against Iran remain on the table, including economic, military, diplomatic, and covert operations, signals heightened US pressure campaign. The successful US operation moving 18 million barrels of oil via tankers demonstrates sustained maritime flow despite regional tensions.
sections.intelligence_notes: Israeli political leadership appears unified in preparing for potential military action against Iran, with Netanyahu expressing conviction about ability to overthrow the Iranian regime as the central mission. US-Iranian confrontation has expanded into cyber domain with Iranian hackers targeting US water infrastructure and CIA attributing attacks to Iranian threat actors. The combination of military posturing, economic warfare, and cyber operations creates multiple potential escalation vectors. Trump administration's stated preparation for any scenario in Iran, combined with explicit US protection of commercial shipping in Hormuz, indicates sustained direct US involvement in regional deterrence.
